occurrences.finding: Incident/Illness Report Form Shared with Parent: An incident did occur when the child put a bead in his nose, but an incident report was not made and was not shared with the parent.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Incident/Illness Report Form Shared with Parent (26 TAC §746.707)

occurrences.finding: AP Report Child Injury Requiring Medical Treatment by a Health-Care Professional or Hospitalization: The child who had a bead stuck in his nose needed medical attention that was not reported to CCR.
occurrences.violation_type_title: AP Report Child Injury Requiring Medical Treatment by a Health-Care Professional or Hospitalization (26 TAC §746.305(a)(2))

occurrences.finding: Child/Caregiver Ratio - 18 Months Difference in Age: There were 15 children in care. The youngest was 14 months and the oldest was 33 months old. With the rule that the age difference between oldest and youngest cannot exceed 18 months, the oldest can only be 32 months in order to stay in ratio. There were 3 children 33 months old on that record. Standard 746.1605(1) will be cited.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Child/Caregiver Ratio - 18 Months Difference in Age (26 TAC §746.1605(1))

occurrences.finding: Diaper Changing Steps- Prompt: A caregiver failed to promptly change a diaper after a parent made mention of the soiled diaper.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Diaper Changing Steps- Prompt (26 TAC §746.3501(1))

occurrences.finding: Licensing Incident/Illness Report Form - Situations Placing Children at Risk: During the investigation, it was found that the operation did not complete an incident report for an inappropriate discipline incident that placed a child at risk.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Licensing Incident/Illness Report Form - Situations Placing Children at Risk (26 TAC §746.701(5))

occurrences.finding: Report Situation Placing Children at Risk: It was found that an inappropriate discipline incident occurred, but the operation did not report it to CCR.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Report Situation Placing Children at Risk (26 TAC §746.305(a)(6))

occurrences.finding: Prohibited Punishments - Grabbing and Pulling: During the investigation, it was found that a caregiver dragged a child by her wrist from one area of the playground to another.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Prohibited Punishments - Grabbing and Pulling (26 TAC §746.2805(3))

occurrences.finding: Prohibited Punishments - Humiliating, Rejecting, Yelling: During the investigation, it was found that a caregiver used harsh language when speaking to children.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Prohibited Punishments - Humiliating, Rejecting, Yelling (26 TAC §746.2805(5))

occurrences.finding: AP Report Child Injury Requiring Medical Treatment by a Health-Care Professional or Hospitalization: A child was hurt in care on 3/6/2026, and the operation did not call CCR to report the incident.
occurrences.violation_type_title: AP Report Child Injury Requiring Medical Treatment by a Health-Care Professional or Hospitalization (26 TAC §746.305(a)(2))

occurrences.finding: Children Handwashing After Toileting or Diapering: One caregiver did not help a child wash their hands after diapering. She was walking him back to his napmat when I asked her to wash his hands.
